a = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B = a[...,0],a[...,2]; lum=a.mean(2)
H,W = lum.shape
# classify each pixel
def cls(p):
    r,g,b = p
    L=(r+g+b)/3
    if L<45: return '#'      # near black
    if r>120 and r>g+12 and g>b+12: return 'S' # skin
    if r>110 and g>90 and b<110 and r>=g and g>b+12: return 'w' # wood/tan
    if L<85: return ':'      # dark gray/brown
    if L>170: return '.'     # bright
    return ' '
# downsample blocks 3x4 -> 85 wide x36 tall
bh,bw=4,3
for y in range(0,H,bh):
    line=''
    for x in range(0,W,bw):
        block=a[y:y+bh,x:x+bw].reshape(-1,3)
        # majority class
        from collections import Counter
        c=Counter(cls(p) for p in block)
        line+=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    print(line)
\"
